name: CareerPath AI WebMCP Actions
description: Standard WebMCP & Model Context Protocol agent actions specification for autonomous AI browsing agents (Chrome AI, Gemini, Claude Computer Use, Operator). Enables structured automation of career diagnostics, roadmap creation, job discovery, and credential verification.

actions.name: Start Career Assessment Diagnostic
actions.description: Initiates the 4-step comprehensive career diagnostic evaluating academic background, interests, and verified technical competencies across 24 industry streams.

course.description: Degree or program, e.g., 'BCA', 'B.Tech Computer Science', 'MCA'

branch.description: Branch or major, e.g., 'Computer Science', 'Artificial Intelligence'

interests.description: List of selected interest domains, e.g. ['Web Development', 'Problem Solving']

skills.description: Map of skill names and calibrated proficiency levels

careerGoals.description: Primary career aspirations or learning milestone target

actions.name: Verify Issued Credential
actions.description: Cryptographically verifies an anti-cheat proctored milestone completion credential against the immutable SHA-256 skill evidence registry.

certificateId.description: Unique certificate identifier to verify, e.g., 'CP-2026-DEMO' or 'CP-BCA-2025-9921'

actions.name: Get Matched Career Routes
actions.description: Retrieves ranked career matches generated by the 60% skills, 25% interests, 15% academics deterministic scoring engine.

includeSkillGap.description: Whether to return matched, developing, and missing skills breakdown

actions.name: Generate 4-Week Milestone Roadmap
actions.description: Generates a structured, milestone-paced execution roadmap for a selected career target with weekly tasks and anti-cheat proctored tests.

careerTitle.description: Target career title, e.g., 'Full Stack Web Developer', 'AI/ML Engineer'

actions.name: Search Verified Job Board
actions.description: Filters direct employer job and internship openings matched with student skill scores and 1-click apply capabilities.

actions.name: Explore Career Universe 3D
actions.description: Navigates all 24 curated career disciplines with required skills, market demand indicators, and salary projections.
